spiritgiven.comments: Thanks for the game! Excellent use of hand signals and very positive.

Very well spirited!  Loved sharing the field with you all.  Loved celebrating each other's huge plays and very hard fought.  Several times you called your own selves down when we would have been happy the disc was up.  Good communication with spirit captain as well discussing level of physicality and making sure everyone was happy.  Best of luck!
Hard competitive game! Enjoyable and intense. We felt the communication was high, quick and friendly.  Physicality on both teams could be improved but all calls resolved quickly and fairly
Thanks for the intense game! Very positive and hard fought.  Good communication that was positive throughout the game. The call at the end went long though.  Good luck for the rest of the games.
Hard game in the wind.  Thanks for a lovely game. Loved how fair-minded you were.
Great to play you.  We felt fairmindedness could be improved. Thanks for the very positive attitude!  Potential to improve some body contact.
Great game!  Loved playing with you. Best of luck!
Extremely fair minded and very positive despite the stakes. Thanks for the game.  We loved playing you.
Amazing final! Thanks for the hard fought and positive game!

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for a great and tough game. A few bids with bumps both ways, but you showed us how to make very nice clean Ds for the vast majority of it.

Thank you for great game!
It was very fantastic!
cheered for the opponents and were generally positive

Gday mates!! What a wonderful game!!!
So nice communication!!
See you somewhere sometime!!
